```python
def mask_to_world_points(mask, depth, K, cam_ext):
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    zs = depth[ys, xs]
    valid = zs > 0
    xs, ys, zs = xs[valid], ys[valid], zs[valid]
    fx, fy = K[0, 0], K[1, 1]
    cx, cy = K[0, 2], K[1, 2]
    xc = (xs - cx) * zs / fx
    yc = (ys - cy) * zs / fy
    pts_cam = np.stack([xc, yc, zs], axis=1)
    pts_cam_h = np.concatenate([pts_cam, np.ones((pts_cam.shape[0], 1))], axis=1)
    pts_world = (cam_ext @ pts_cam_h.T).T[:, :3]
    return pts_world

red_pts = mask_to_world_points(red_mask, depth, K, cam_ext)
green_pts = mask_to_world_points(green_mask, depth, K, cam_ext)

red_obb = get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points(red_pts)
green_obb = get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points(green_pts)

print("red center", red_obb["center"], "extent", red_obb["extent"])
print("green center", green_obb["center"], "extent", green_obb["extent"])
```

red_pts = mask_to_world_points(red_mask, depth, K, cam_ext)
green_pts = mask_to_world_points(green_mask, depth, K, cam_ext)
red_obb = get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points(red_pts)
green_obb = get_oriented_bounding_box_from_3d_points(green_pts)

red_center = red_obb["center"]
green_center = green_obb["center"]
red_extent = red_obb["extent"]
green_extent = green_obb["extent"]
print("red center", red_center, "extent", red_extent)
print("green center", green_center, "extent", green_extent)

# Check if red is already on top of green
xy_dist = np.linalg.norm(red_center[:2] - green_center[:2])
z_diff = red_center[2] - green_center[2]
print("xy_dist", xy_dist, "z_diff", z_diff)

if xy_dist < 0.03 and z_diff > 0.03:
    print("Red cube already on top of green cube. Opening gripper.")
    open_gripper()
else:
    # Need to place red on green. First grasp red cube.
    red_seg = red_mask.astype(np.int32)
    r_poses, r_scores = plan_grasp(depth=depth, intrinsics=K, segmentation=red_seg)
    r_idx = r_scores.argmax()
    r_T_world = cam_ext @ r_poses[r_idx]
    r_grasp_pos = r_T_world[:3, 3]
    r_grasp_quat = quat_wxyz_from_mat(r_T_world)

    r_pre = r_grasp_pos.copy(); r_pre[2] += 0.10
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(r_pre, r_grasp_quat))
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(r_grasp_pos, r_grasp_quat))
    close_gripper()

    r_lift = r_grasp_pos.copy(); r_lift[2] += 0.20
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(r_lift, r_grasp_quat))

    # Place on top of green
    green_top_z = green_center[2] + green_extent[2] / 2.0
    red_half_z = red_extent[2] / 2.0
    target_z = green_top_z + red_half_z + 0.005
    target_xy = green_center[:2]

    above_target = np.array([target_xy[0], target_xy[1], target_z + 0.12])
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(above_target, r_grasp_quat))
    place_target = np.array([target_xy[0], target_xy[1], target_z])
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(place_target, r_grasp_quat))
    open_gripper()

    final_retreat = place_target.copy(); final_retreat[2] += 0.15
    move_to_joints(solve_ik(final_retreat, r_grasp_quat))
